title: The Organize Media Folder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Organize Media Folder plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of the EXIF.DateTimeOriginal parameter. This vulnerability affects all versions up to and including 2.00. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. Exploitation at subscriber level requires the presence and configuration of bbPress and gd-bbpress-attachments plugins to allow frontend attachment uploads. Without this configuration, an attacker needs author-level access or higher to exploit the vulnerability.
